description: Land Acquisition - Kulugammana, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically for acquiring a 0.0250 hectare plot of land for a water supply project. It contains detailed descriptions of the land location, boundaries, and procedures for compensation claims, making it primarily about land and property matters rather than government personnel or structure.
